SELECT 
  p.name,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status = 'Returned')::double precision / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'), 0) AS return_rate,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled') AS non_cancelled_items
FROM public.order_items oi
JOIN public.inventory_items ii ON ii.id = oi.inventory_item_id
JOIN public.products p ON p.id = ii.product_id
WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled') >= 100
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Purchase' THEN session_id END)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS conversion_rate FROM public.events WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH jan_2024_users AS (
  SELECT id, created_at
  FROM public.users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    u.id,
    u.created_at AS user_created_at,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.order_id END) AS non_cancelled_orders
  FROM jan_2024_users u
  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at 
    AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
  GROUP BY u.id, u.created_at
)
SELECT 
  ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE non_cancelled_orders >= 2)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 4) AS share_with_two_plus_orders
FROM user_orders

SELECT u.traffic_source, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue_per_user FROM public.users u JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01' AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT 
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 3600.0) AS median_hours_to_delivery
FROM public.order_items
WHERE status = 'Complete' 
  AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
  AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL
